description: A light green bowl sits on the bed in front of several small toy items, including a white egg-shaped piece, black bead-like pieces, a yellow fish, and a red tomato slice. The right hand moves in from the right, reaches down to grasp the white egg-shaped piece as the right-hand object, lifts it up and carries it leftward over the bowl, then releases it so it drops into the bowl; the right hand then pulls back away without touching anything.
